### Bible Pathways 06/10/2002
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-06-or-10-or-2002-1140948.html
Passage: Nehemiah 11:1-2
Points:
- Jerusalem lacked enough residents to defend and maintain it, so leaders settled there while others were chosen by lot or stepped forward voluntarily.
- Relocating into the city required people to surrender personal convenience and farming livelihoods for the sake of God's holy city.
- Believers are challenged to examine whether worldly pursuits have broken down their spiritual walls and weakened their zeal for the Lord.
- Christians should beware of allowing even good activities to distract from offering their time and treasures in faithful service to God.
